provenance.refreshMethod: Assistant browser retrieval of primary online Nepali material on 2026-10-09, using full page or PDF text where available and explicitly limited indexed excerpts where retrieval failed. This is source-assisted corroboration; no human review is claimed.

policy.accuracyScope: Selected project development references; these cases are implementation targets and cannot measure independent held-out or population accuracy.
policy.romanIntent: Whole-form Nepali attestation supports the spelling but does not independently establish the informal Roman writer’s intended word or a deterministic keyboard mapping.
policy.implementationScope: Exact lowercase lexical entries, with existing explicit keyboard behavior protected by the runtime’s established policy.
policy.singleReferenceOrder: The twelve single-output targets retain frozen preferredReferenceIndex 0.
policy.ambiguousAlternativeOrder: bhagna retains frozen reference order [भाग्न, भग्न] and preferredReferenceIndex null. implementationEntries uses [भग्न, भाग्न] solely to preserve the existing engine default भग्न while exposing the missing भाग्न alternative. This ordering makes no linguistic frequency or unique-intent claim.
policy.sourceAccess: verifiedAt records the browser check date. Browser line numbers are retrieval locators and may change. Full-page scope means returned HTML text was inspected; indexed-snippet and uninspected visual pages remain explicitly limited.
policy.copyright: Only narrow spelling support notes and source metadata are recorded; full articles, sentences and poems are not reproduced.
